links.outcome: Rate of possible harm in ChatGPT-drafted answers versus anesthesiologist answers, rated by blinded anesthesiologists
links.effect: Possibility of harm 4.7% for ChatGPT vs 1.7% for the anesthesiologist (p = .04); agreement with scientific consensus 96.6% vs 99.3% (p = .02).
links.quote: ChatGPT underperformed the anesthesiologist regarding rate of responses in agreement with scientific consensus (96.6% vs. 99.3%, p = .02) and possibility of harm (4.7% vs. 1.7%, p = .04), but performed similarly in other measures (percentage of responses with inappropriate/incorrect information (5.7% vs. 2.7%, p = .07) and missing information (10.0% vs. 7.0%, p = .19)).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses compared to an anesthesiologist's responses to simulated patient questions using expert physician graders without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
